name: plainwright-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android automation with Appium actions and Jev decisions; record and replay natural-language YAML tests

interface.shortDescription: Drive and test native iOS and Android apps.
interface.longDescription: Use Appium to drive native iOS and Android apps, including React Native. Jev resolves natural-language targets and assertions from native UI trees. Record and replay YAML specs on simulators, emulators or physical devices.
interface.defaultPrompt: Test a mobile app with plainwright-mobile.
